Move to a four-day week

One reason for this position is that the data shows a consistent and sustained increase in revenue per employee for firms that adopted the four-day week model. Specifically, revenue per employee was 2.4% higher for four-day firms compared to five-day firms after two years, with the gap widening over time. This indicates that the long-term benefits of the four-day week outweigh any short-term challenges, such as the initial dip in revenue due to reduced headcount from lower attrition.
